name: Hunter

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A protector of civilization who studies prey and specializes in bringing down giants or hordes.

feature.name: Hunter's Lore
feature.summary: While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know its Immunities, Resistances and Vulnerabilities.
feature.text: You can call on the forces of nature to reveal a target's strengths and weaknesses. While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know whether it has any Immunities, Resistances or Vulnerabilities, and what they are.

feature.name: Hunter's Prey
feature.summary: Choose Colossus Slayer (+1d8 against a wounded target once per turn) or Horde Breaker (an extra attack on a creature next to your target); swap it on a rest.
feature.text: Choose one of these options; whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest you can swap it for the other. Colossus Slayer: once per turn, when you hit a creature that is missing any of its Hit Points with a weapon, it takes an extra 1d8 damage. Horde Breaker: once on each of your turns when you attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within the weapon's range.

options.name: Colossus Slayer
options.summary: Once per turn, +1d8 damage against a creature missing any Hit Points.

options.name: Horde Breaker
options.summary: Once per turn, attack a second creature within 5 feet of your target.

feature.name: Defensive Tactics
feature.summary: Choose Escape the Horde (Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage) or Multiattack Defense (after a creature hits you, its other attacks this turn have Disadvantage); swap it on a rest.
feature.text: Choose one of these options; whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest you can swap it for the other. Escape the Horde: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage. Multiattack Defense: when a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

options.name: Escape the Horde
options.summary: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

options.name: Multiattack Defense
options.summary: After a creature hits you, its other attacks against you this turn have Disadvantage.

feature.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
feature.summary: Once per turn, when Hunter's Mark damages a creature, deal the same extra damage to another creature within 30 feet of it.

feature.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
feature.summary: Reaction when you take damage: Resistance to that damage and that type until the end of the turn.
